eshan.name: Eshan College of Engineering & Management
notes: Its current general fee page lists a first-year B.Tech CS merit scholarship of ₹25,000 for 60–80% in Intermediate and ₹5,000 above 80%.
The college's B.Tech CS course page lists ₹2,500 (not ₹25,000) for 60–80%, with ₹5,000 above 80%. The official pages conflict; confirm the amount directly before relying on it.
For B.Tech CE/EE/ME, the fee page lists ₹15,000 for 60%–80% or JEE-qualified candidates. Eligibility and amounts vary by course.

notes: The college admission page asks scholarship applicants for supporting documents, but we could not verify a fixed institutional PCM-based amount on its current official pages.

Eligible students can check the Uttar Pradesh post-matric scholarship / fee-reimbursement schemes. The award depends on the live government rules, course, category and family-income criteria; this site does not estimate an amount.

government.name: Uttar Pradesh Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement
notes: The District Mathura administration lists scholarship, book-bank and fee-reimbursement schemes and points students to the official UP Scholarship portal.
Government awards are eligibility- and scheme-based, not a guaranteed college discount. Check the active 2026–27 notice, dates and eligibility directly on the portal.
